instructions_to_main_agent: Replace stock placeholder splash in App.js immediately with full high-visual-impact landing page.
Ensure Lenis smooth scroll and framer-motion animations give an organic weight to scrolling.
Implement neon green (#00FF99) and spray silver (#E2E8F0) glow highlights over pure dark obsidian background (#060608).
Make the WhatsApp buttons trigger direct wa.me links with custom pre-filled message in Portuguese.
Add interactive pricing tab / quick booking flow that leads straight to WhatsApp.
Ensure all key elements contain data-testid attributes specified in test_ids.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Do NOT use dark colors as standard gradients. Use pure high-contrast obsidian dark solid backgrounds with subtle noise texture and glows.
Never center-align whole body containers; use asymmetrical bento grid layouts.
Every interaction needs micro-animations: hover scale, glow transitions, scroll triggers.
Use 2-3x generous spacing with explicit padding inside containers to prevent text collisions.
Never use raw transparent header backgrounds over scrolled text; always use backdrop-blur glassmorphism (bg-black/70 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10).
All interactive buttons and key info blocks MUST include data-testid attributes.
